description: E26 line-by-line accounting of the archived unierp-app-fieldservice repository. Every archived source file is disposed as PORTED (logic carried forward), REWRITTEN (re-expressed against the public extension API), or DROPPED (with a reason). Enforced by scripts/check-e26-port.mjs.

entries.reason: Prisma models re-expressed as declared extension schema entities (ext_field_service_<entity> with tenant_id+RLS); field-service data is service-owned with core references by ID only.
Prisma CLI config; the extension has no Prisma data layer.
NestJS bootstrap; the platform is the host for extensions.
NestJS controller endpoints re-expressed as customRoutes handlers.
Dispatch board, assignment, status transitions, SLA and PM look-ahead logic carried forward as pure functions.
Core event fan-out was monolith infrastructure; extension events are a manifest scope, not a local HTTP endpoint.
NestJS CRUD controller endpoints re-expressed as customRoutes handlers.
Ticket/dispatch/checklist/PM CRUD logic carried forward as pure functions over in-memory record sets.
NestJS HTTP bootstrap; the platform loads extension factories.
Prisma client; extensions have no direct DB handle.
Authorization is enforced by the platform via manifest scope grants; the extension cannot self-authorize.
Tenant identity is provided by the platform context (ExtensionContext.tenantId).
